mapper.update: INSERT INTO market_price (symbol, last_price, bid, ask, currency, change, change_percent, previous_close, market_state, stale, quote_as_of, updated_on) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{lastPrice}, #{bid}, #{ask}, #{currency}, #{change}, #{changePercent}, #{previousClose}, #{marketState}, #{stale}, #{quoteAsOf}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET last_price = EXCLUDED.last_price, bid = EXCLUDED.bid, ask = EXCLUDED.ask, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, change = EXCLUDED.change, change_percent = EXCLUDED.change_percent, previous_close = EXCLUDED.previous_close, market_state = EXCLUDED.market_state, stale = EXCLUDED.stale, quote_as_of = EXCLUDED.quote_as_of, updated_on = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_history (symbol, price, bid, ask, quote_as_of) SELECT #{symbol}, CAST(#{price} AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{bid} AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{ask} AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{quoteAsOf} AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT price, quote_as_of FROM price_history WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY quote_as_of DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) latest WHERE latest.price = CAST(#{price} AS NUMERIC) AND latest.quote_as_of = CAST(#{quoteAsOf} AS TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, last_price, bid, ask, currency, change, change_percent, previous_close, market_state, stale, quote_as_of FROM market_price ORDER BY symbol
SELECT symbol, last_price, bid, ask, currency, change, change_percent, previous_close, market_state, stale, quote_as_of FROM market_price WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
